recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: boolean riddles braided through the morning feed—true, false, true
a terminal wearing depth behind the monospace veil
marine spring holding san francisco in sweater fog at eleven degrees
sunset creeping toward nine while the clouds keep the edges soft
stutter-house pulses drifting against slow country-quiet interludes
a quiet forge week: keyboards cooling while playlists keep time

composer-2-fast.concept: Ride quantized basslanes under a drifting marine layer—you swap lanes so a glowing courier slips through teleport-stutter barriers that only move on off-beats.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: one short track-length round feels like surfing compression artifacts with clean near-misses.
composer-2-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, lanes pinch, phantom blocks appear on syncopated beats.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: ultraviolet wireframe subway under rain-streaked glass

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick pastel dream-pop motes into three temperature cones before they bloom into static—wrong bin smears the glass and eats your buffer.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: flick-sort with soft arc physics and magnetic snap
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag to aim, release to flick
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing a full wave triggers a kaleidoscopic collapse that reads like exhaling.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: near-duplicate hues, rotating bins, shorter fuse timers.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: blurred polaroid layers and chalky pastel smear

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Draw one unbroken circuit between agent-nodes on a hex patch; completed graphs 'compile' into a single satisfying pulse of mint light.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: one-stroke path drawing with connection rules
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: drag to trace paths between nodes
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: each solved graph lands like a micro-ship—a tiny coherent closure.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: dead cells, one-way edges, shrinking ink allowance.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: dark UI chrome with mint signal traces and paper texture

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Remember hidden door flashes along a foggy row-house facade, then tap them back in order as floorboard pressure speeds up.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: the façade inhales on mistakes and exhales relief on perfect chains.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: mirror duplicates, bait panels, shortening preview windows.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: gouache townhouse fronts with pea-soup fog in the windows
